result.topic_en: A third calculation: 455938128 is factored as 144·3166237, the factorisation 3166237 = 107·127·233 is found by developing the period of a reduced quadratic form, and a quantity A = N e^δ is set up with high-precision decimal values of δ, δ' and the exponentials e^δ, e^δ'.

methods.what: Finding divisors of a number by developing the period of a reduced binary quadratic form of that determinant and using a square form in the period to obtain a congruence of squares
methods.quote: Die Divisoren der Zahl 3166237 fand man, indem man die Periode der reducirten form $(1, 1779, -1396)$ entwickelte, in welcher die form $(-1897, 530, 1521)$ die sechste war. Hier-aus $(11 + 28.1779)^2 \equiv 1521 = 39^2$, und $3166237 = 107\cdot127\cdot233$.

methods.what: Writing a quantity A as a nearby rational number times an exponential correction e^δ for high-precision computation
